reviewedTree: d6fc3384 + working tree (4 post-baseline commits, none touching reported locations)
scope: monorepo only; engine reviewed at TypeScript boundary contract; sibling repos out of scope

threatActors.T2: authenticated/tenant attacker (incl. holder of a workspace-bound credential)

findings.title: Workspace-bound API keys/OAuth tokens read other workspaces on routes and dashboard pages that check membership only
findings.issue: getSession() falls back to getBearerSession() populating session.apiKey.workspaceId / session.oauth.workspaceId, but these routes check only workspaceMember for session.userId — the binding check in requireWorkspaceAccess (session.ts:317-322) is never invoked. Dashboard resolves active workspace from the unsigned client-settable activeWorkspaceId cookie filtered by user memberships only.
findings.impact: A credential bound to workspace A whose backing user is also a member of workspace B reads B's targets, projects, full member roster + pending invitation emails, and all dashboard pages for B. RLS does not mitigate — the Prisma extension binds RLS context from the query's own attacker-chosen workspaceId.
findings.evidence: targets/route.ts:286-294 membership probe then findMany({workspaceId}); cache.ts:28-31 selectActiveWorkspaceId(memberships, cookieStore.get('activeWorkspaceId')); correct pattern at workspaces/route.ts:28-39,129-131.
findings.fix: Route all workspace-scoped reads through requireWorkspaceAccess(workspaceId); clamp getCachedWorkspaceContext to the credential's bound workspace when session.apiKey/session.oauth present.

findings.title: OAuth bearer sessions bypass credential-type rejection and write-scope enforcement — read/delegated tokens mint durable lsk_ write keys and publish public scorecards
findings.issue: requireWorkspaceAccess enforces workspace binding + role only; scope split and delegated-operation grants live exclusively in requirePermission (session.ts:356-380). Callers hand-rolling the credential-type check test only session.apiKey and forget session.oauth; withCookieMutation skips the same-origin gate for Bearer requests by design.
findings.impact: An OAuth token with only lyrashield.read (or a delegated agentConnection constrained by allowedOperations/allowedTargetIds) whose subject is ADMIN mints a durable lsk_ key with scopes ['read','write'] — privilege escalation plus a persistent credential surviving connection revocation. Read-scoped tokens can also publish public unauthenticated scorecards and act on the creator's affiliate payout method/requests.
findings.evidence: api-keys/route.ts:57-59 rejects session.apiKey only, then createApiKey({workspaceId, scopes, createdById}) returns rawKey once; connection-auth.ts:7 shows the correct both-types rejection.
findings.fix: Reject session.oauth alongside session.apiKey on api-keys and affiliate mutation routes; use requirePermission (mutating permission) or extend scope checks to session.oauth for scorecard publish/revoke.

findings.title: Affiliate 12-month commission cap is unreachable dead code — every renewal mints a full commission for the life of the subscription
findings.issue: AffiliateSubscription (firstPaidAt/capEndsAt) is created only inside else-if(isFirstPayment); the flag is read from event metadata but no production code stamps it (checkout metadata lacks it; grep shows writers only in tests). findUnique on providerSubscriptionId always misses → capEndsAt stays null → the capMonths expiry branch is unreachable.
findings.impact: Contractual cap (capMonths default 12, public affiliate page copy) unenforced: LAUNCH_ASSURANCE annual ($4,188) mints ~$1,047 commission every year forever; monthly plans mint on every renewal up to 100-year total_count. Commissions accrue as payable liability; cash realization currently gated by admin-disabled payout path. Side effects: activeReferrals never increments, Conversion.subscriptionId null, clawback decrement unreachable.
findings.evidence: engine.ts:289 else-if(isFirstPayment); domain-events.ts:408 Boolean(facts.metaBag?.isFirstPayment); checkout metadata shape has no isFirstPayment; repo grep: writers only in *.test.ts/e2e.
findings.fix: Upsert AffiliateSubscription on providerSubscriptionId with capEndsAt = firstSeen + capMonths (first observed paid event is the first payment); apply expiry branch on subsequent events; backfill from earliest Conversion.occurredAt.

findings.title: Git option injection via unvalidated --base/--head arguments in CLI diff commands
findings.issue: User-supplied base/head placed into git diff argv with no --end-of-options and no ref validation; a leading '--' arg is parsed as a git option. (The '--' at :109/:141 protects only the file arg.)
findings.impact: lyrashield gate --base=--output=<path> redirects diff output to arbitrary files — destroys ~/.lyrashield/credentials.json, shell rc, SSH files; attacker-authored commit filenames partially control content. Secondary: head interpolated into git show object spec.
findings.evidence: diff-core.ts:89 argv [..., base, head]; resolveDiffRange :74-85 passthrough; repo's own workflow uses rev-parse --verify --end-of-options (lyrashield-scan.yml:79,83) — pattern known, not applied in CLI.
findings.fix: Resolve refs via git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options "${ref}^{commit}" and pass only 40-char SHAs; or reject args starting with '-'.
findings.note: Replacement wave E overturned the original wave's verified-safe claim on this path — re-verified in source during consolidation.

findings.title: lyrashield login --key places the API key in process argv
findings.issue: -k/--key flag embeds the long-lived lsk_ key in argv (world-readable via /proc/ps on multi-user hosts) and shell history; CI logs command lines.
findings.impact: Durable credential exposure outside the 0600 credential store until revoked.
findings.evidence: login.ts:53-56 flag def; :62 direct assignment; safe stdin/hidden-prompt alternatives exist in the same function.
findings.fix: Remove --key/-k or deprecate toward stdin/hidden prompt; document never-use-in-CI; optionally scrub process.argv after read.

findings.title: Production secrets present in env while pnpm install executes dependency build scripts
findings.issue: onlyBuiltDependencies/allowBuilds permit install-time code execution; production DATABASE_URL (and in production-backup.yml all backup creds via workflow-level env) share that env although no install step needs them.
findings.impact: One malicious release of a build-allowed dep exfiltrates prod direct-DB URL / backup passphrase + R2 keys.
findings.fix: Split pnpm install into a secret-free step; bind secrets at step scope only; never workflow-level env for secrets.

findings.title: Deploy/backup tooling fetched unpinned at run time while holding production credentials
findings.issue: wranglerVersion '4' installs latest wrangler 4.x with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; production-backup.yml:78-82 runs mutable postgres:17-alpine with prod DB URL.
findings.impact: Compromised wrangler/postgres release → prod Cloudflare token / prod DB URL exfiltration.
findings.fix: Pin wranglerVersion exactly or via lockfile devDependency; pin postgres/redis images by sha256 digest.

findings.title: minimumReleaseAge: 7 is seven minutes, not days
findings.issue: pnpm interprets the bare number as minutes; intended 7-day cooldown is 10080.
findings.impact: Publish-age supply-chain gate effectively absent; a malicious fresh version lands within minutes.

findings.title: Shipped scan workflow runs unpinned pip install safety / npx pnpm in consumers' CI
findings.issue: Unpinned PyPI/npm installs execute latest published artifacts; workflow is workflow_call-consumable and runs in customer CI with a job token holding security-events: write among other scopes.
findings.impact: Compromised safety/pnpm release → arbitrary code exec in every adopting repo's scan job; can force vuln_found=0 / poison SARIF — the gate reports clean.
findings.fix: Pin pnpm via corepack prepare pnpm@X.Y.Z or SHA-pinned pnpm/setup; pip install safety==<ver> --require-hashes from a committed requirements lock; or vendor the audit step into a pinned image.
findings.note: Independently reported by both Wave E (VULN-E-003) and Wave H; single canonical finding.

findings.title: secureCookies fails open on non-HTTPS BETTER_AUTH_URL
findings.issue: useSecureCookies/session Secure flag derived from BETTER_AUTH_URL scheme; env.ts:26 accepts any URL — no production https: refine. Config-dependent precondition, not attacker input.
findings.impact: Prod config typo silently ships session cookies without Secure → MITM session theft window.
findings.fix: Schema refine requiring https: for BETTER_AUTH_URL when NODE_ENV=production (or non-loopback host).

findings.title: Unsigned last_server_verified_at enables perpetual offline grace — license revocation bypass
findings.issue: 7-day offline grace anchors on plaintext timestamp in user-writable license.json; ed25519 covers only payload fields; rewriting the timestamp + blocking the API keeps a revoked license operational forever.
findings.impact: Server revocation never lands; revoked/refunded license keeps scanning/syncing indefinitely.
findings.fix: Server-signed revalidation receipt inside signed blob, or HMAC StoredLicense with keychain-held key; or cap accumulated offline time.

findings.title: Engine stdout/stderr ingested with no line-length/rate/total cap — memory + disk exhaustion
findings.issue: BufReader::lines() buffers unbounded lines; every line persisted to scan_events and emitted over IPC; no caps.
findings.impact: Hostile scan-target output → OOM/disk fill/IPC flood during a legitimate scan.
findings.fix: Truncate lines >64KiB, byte-budgeted reads, cap/batch persisted events, bound total stream bytes then kill child.

findings.title: ApiClient reads unbounded response bodies; error paths echo body to UI
findings.issue: resp.text() buffers whole body; 30s timeout bounds duration not size; non-2xx bodies echoed into SyncResult::Error.message.
findings.impact: Memory exhaustion/crash on a single malicious response (requires server compromise or MITM-class position).
findings.fix: Hard byte cap (~1-5 MiB); never embed raw body in error strings.

findings.title: mask_key byte-slices UTF-8 — panics on multibyte API keys
findings.issue: &key[..4]/&key[len-4..] panic mid-char; validation accepts non-ASCII keys and stores untrimmed.
findings.impact: Persistent IPC failure/crash loop on BYOK status reads; recoverable only via clear_azure_config.
findings.fix: Require api_key.is_ascii(); boundary-safe masking via chars().take(4).

findings.title: Marketing site serves full content over plaintext HTTP — no HTTPS redirect
findings.issue: http://lyrashieldai.com/, /pricing, http://www.lyrashieldai.com/ all return HTTP/1.1 200 with content; middleware strips upgrade-insecure-requests for http: — code anticipates HTTP rather than redirecting. Cloudflare zone 'Always Use HTTPS' not in effect.
findings.impact: MITM can modify served marketing content (defacement, link injection) on the plaintext path; HSTS preload mitigates preload-aware browsers only.
findings.evidence: Live probe 2026-09-11: curl http://lyrashieldai.com/ → 200 text/html (no Location). http://app.lyrashieldai.com/ correctly 301s.
findings.fix: Enable Always Use HTTPS at the Cloudflare zone, or 301 on url.protocol==='http:' in the worker/middleware.

needsVerification.title: Stale signed-event regression of subscription state
needsVerification.note: Upsert overwrites status/period unconditionally; an out-of-order signed event can regress currentPeriodStart and re-widen the balance window. Bounded by prior-cycle leftover minutes; no tenant-controlled reordering found.

needsVerification.title: Mid-cycle plan change grants a second full pool without revoking the first
needsVerification.note: Grant key {accountId}:{cycleStartIso}:{plan} — a plan-change event at the same cycleStart mints a second pool while the first remains counted. Self-serve plan change appears unreachable today (Polar portal passes subscription id as customerId; Razorpay has no self-serve plan change).

needsVerification.note: After workspace hard-delete the lookup can never match → refunded minutes stay spendable; symmetric late-payment path fails FK → paid-never-credited. No user-reachable hard-delete exists; latent for ops/support flows.
